q: A Group 2 building (e.g., a school) has a PCC of P150,000,000. Using the DAEDS bracket (P5,500,000 + 4% of excess over P100.0M), what is the Professional Fee?
n: Group 2 DAEDS bracket for P100M—P200M: P5,500,000 + 4% of excess over P100M. Excess = P50M; 4% × P50M = P2,000,000. Total = P5,500,000 + P2,000,000 = P7,500,000. [Source: Sec. 6.3, Group 2 DAEDS table]

q: A Group 3 hospital project has a PCC of P300,000,000. Using the DAEDS bracket (P11,500,000 + 4% of excess over P200.0M), what is the Professional Fee?
n: Group 3 DAEDS bracket for P200M—P500M: P11,500,000 + 4% of excess over P200M. Excess = P100M; 4% × P100M = P4,000,000. Total = P11,500,000 + P4,000,000 = P15,500,000. [Source: Sec. 6.3, Group 3 DAEDS table]

q: An industrial plant (Group 1) is engaged under DADS with a PCC of P120,000,000. Using the DADS bracket (P2,700,000 + 1.8% of excess over P100.0M), what is the Professional Fee?
n: Group 1 DADS bracket for P100M—P200M: P2,700,000 + 1.8% of excess over P100M. Excess = P20M; 1.8% × P20M = P360,000. Total = P2,700,000 + P360,000 = P3,060,000. [Source: Sec. 6.3, Group 1 DADS table]

q: A single-detached residence (Group 4) has a PCC of P20,000,000 and is engaged under DADS (6% of PCC). What is the Professional Fee?
n: Group 4 DADS is a flat 6% of PCC (architecture-only scope). 6% × P20,000,000 = P1,200,000. [Source: Sec. 6.3, Group 4]

q: A developer builds 4 identical retail branches (Group 6, Repetitive Construction) using the same unamended plans. If the full RPF for one building of this type is P5,000,000, what is the fee for the 4th building?
n: Under Group 6, the 4th building and succeeding units are billed at 30% of the RPF for that building type. 30% × P5,000,000 = P1,500,000. [Source: Sec. 6.3, Group 6]

q: An existing office building (Group 2) is being renovated. The renovation's PCC is P40,000,000, and the applicable base DAEDS rate for Group 2 (PCC ≤ P50M) is 6%. Applying the Group 9 renovation surcharge, what is the total Professional Fee?
n: The building is a Group 2 type (base DAEDS rate 6%), and renovation work under Group 9 is surcharged 150% of the applicable RPF: 6% × 1.5 = 9%. 9% × P40,000,000 = P3,600,000. [Source: Sec. 6.3, Groups 2 and 9]

q: An Architect is summoned as an expert witness for 3 scheduled court hearings, but 2 of the 3 hearings are postponed and do not push through. What is the minimum total fee owed for all 3 appearances?
o: P0 (no fee, since hearings did not push through)
n: As an expert witness, the fee is not less than P5,000.00 per appearance, regardless of whether the scheduled hearing took place. 3 appearances × P5,000 = P15,000. [Source: Sec. 6.3, Group 10]

q: The total Professional Fee (PF) for a project is P10,000,000. What is the cumulative amount due to the Architect upon completion of the Schematic Design phase?
n: Cumulative payment after Schematic Design completion is 20% of PF (5% signing + 15% schematic). 20% × P10,000,000 = P2,000,000. [Source: Sec. 6.4]

q: The total PF for a project is P8,000,000. Within 15 days after the contract is awarded to the winning Constructor, what cumulative amount should the Architect have received?
n: Within 15 days after award to the winning Constructor, cumulative payment reaches 90% of PF (based on the winning bid price). 90% × P8,000,000 = P7,200,000. [Source: Sec. 6.4]

q: (Unit Cost Method): An office building has 5,000 sqm GFA at a historical PCC of P25,000/sqm and a 5% PCC fee, plus 1,000 sqm non-GFA area billed at 50% of the GFA rate. What is the TOTAL fee (GFA + non-GFA)?
n: GFA fee: P25,000 × 0.05 = P1,250/sqm × 5,000 sqm = P6,250,000. Non-GFA fee (50% of GFA rate): P625/sqm × 1,000 sqm = P625,000. Total = P6,250,000 + P625,000 = P6,875,000. [Source: Sec. 4.1.2, Unit Cost Method]

q: (Group 7, Housing Project — DAEDS): A housing project has 15 identical units. If the RPF for the 1st unit alone is P1,000,000, what is the TOTAL fee for all 15 units?
n: Units 2—10 (9 additional units) at 50% of RPF each: 9 × (0.5 × P1,000,000) = P4,500,000, plus the 1st unit's P1,000,000 = P5,500,000 for 10 units. For units 11—15 (5 additional units) at 40% of RPF each: 5 × (0.4 × P1,000,000) = P2,000,000. Total for 15 units = P5,500,000 + P2,000,000 = P7,500,000. [Source: Sec. 6.3, Group 7]

q: A Group 2 building has a PCC of P40,000,000 (within the ≤P50M bracket, base DAEDS rate 6%). The Architect is a Level 2 Specialist (+1.00%), the project uses BIM (+0.10%), and submittals are fast-tracked (+0.10%). What is the total Professional Fee after adjustments?
n: Sub-total rate = 6.00% base + 1.00% (Level 2 Specialist) + 0.10% (BIM) + 0.10% (fast-track) = 7.20%. Since PCC ≤ P50M, the fee is simply 7.20% × P40,000,000 = P2,880,000. [Source: Sec. 6.3, Group 2; Annex D-style adjustment factors]

q: A hotel (Group 3) is engaged under DADS with a PCC of P90,000,000. Using the DADS bracket (P2,100,000 + 3.6% of excess over P50.0M), what is the Professional Fee?
n: Group 3 DADS bracket for P50M—P100M: P2,100,000 + 3.6% of excess over P50M. Excess = P40M; 3.6% × P40M = P1,440,000. Total = P2,100,000 + P1,440,000 = P3,540,000. [Source: Sec. 6.3, Group 3 DADS table]

q: A manufacturing plant (Group 1) is engaged under DADS with a PCC of P250,000,000. Using the DADS bracket (P4,500,000 + 1.2% of excess over P200.0M), what is the Professional Fee?
n: Group 1 DADS bracket for P200M—P500M: P4,500,000 + 1.2% of excess over P200M. Excess = P50M; 1.2% × P50M = P600,000. Total = P4,500,000 + P600,000 = P5,100,000. [Source: Sec. 6.3, Group 1 DADS table]

q: A PCA is engaged on a P50,000/month Retainer for 6 months. During that period, the Client also requests one additional consultation outside the retainer's scope, billed separately at P1,000/hour for 8 hours. What is the PCA's TOTAL compensation for the period?
n: Retainer covers the minimum service obligation: 6 months × P50,000 = P300,000. The additional consultation (outside the retainer scope) is billed separately on an hourly basis: 8 hours × P1,000/hr = P8,000. Total compensation = P300,000 + P8,000 = P308,000. [Source: Sec. 4.3.13, Retainer]
